definitions.explanation: A deep, dark shade of blue, commonly used for uniforms and formal attire.

examples.japanese: {紺|こん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: He's wearing a navy blue suit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紺色|こんいろ}→紺色：13792_koniro⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The school uniform is navy blue.

examples.japanese: {紺|こん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ストライプ→ストライプ：27546_sutoraipu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ネクタイ→ネクタイ：01040_nekutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{似合|にあ}っている→似合う：02134_niau⟧。
examples.english: The navy and white striped tie suits you.

notes:
{紺|こん} is a traditional Japanese color name for dark blue or navy blue. It's one of the most common colors for school uniforms and business attire in Japan.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{紺色|こんいろ}→紺色：13792_koniro⟧ (navy blue color)
- {紺|こん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧ (navy blue suit)
- ⟦{濃紺|のうこん}→濃紺：15616_noukon⟧ (very dark navy blue)

RELATED COLORS:
- ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (blue - general)
- ⟦{藍|あい}→藍：20100_ai⟧ (indigo)
- ⟦{群青|ぐんじょう}→群青：14067_gunjou⟧ (ultramarine)
- ⟦{水色|みずいろ}→水色：15336_mizuiro⟧ (light blue)
